title: Vyop Launch: Smart Voice Billing, Barcode Scanning & Khata App
excerpt: Official launch of Vyop: Barcode Scan & Bill, the smart phone-first barcode POS, voice billing, and digital khata app for retail shopkeepers.
content:
The Future of Business: Launching May 4, 2026

We are thrilled to announce that Vyop: Barcode Scan & Bill is officially launching on May 4, 2026. Designed specifically for the vibrant retail landscape of Bharat, Vyop turns your smartphone into a supermarket-grade barcode scanner and voice billing POS.

Why Every Business Needs Barcode & Voice Billing

In a world where speed at checkout is everything, Vyop allows you to scan product barcodes with your phone camera, speak bills naturally in Hindi or English, and manage credit ledgers effortlessly. No expensive barcode gun or complex desktop software required.

More Than Just Billing: A Complete Retail POS & Khata

As a comprehensive retail solution, Vyop handles everything from barcode scanning to real-time inventory and customer udhar khata.

  • Phone Barcode Scanner: Scan any EAN/UPC barcode with your mobile camera.
  • AI for Loose Items: No barcode? AI handles it with a quick photo.
  • Voice Billing: Just speak, and your bill is generated.
  • Digital Khata: Automated WhatsApp payment reminders for customer credit.

Stay tuned for our grand launch on May 4!
